senses.sense_definition: The act of recognizing or creating a distinction between things.

examples.text: The <w>differentiation</w> between these two products is not immediately obvious to the average consumer.
Clear <w>differentiation</w> of tasks helps the team work more efficiently.

senses.sense_definition: The biological process by which cells or tissues become specialized to perform specific functions.

examples.text: Cell <w>differentiation</w> is a critical stage in the development of an embryo.
Stem cells have the unique ability to undergo <w>differentiation</w> into various specialized cell types.

senses.sense_definition: The mathematical process of calculating the derivative of a function.

examples.text: Students learn the rules of <w>differentiation</w> in their first calculus course.
The <w>differentiation</w> of this complex function requires the chain rule.

senses.sense_definition: The evolutionary process by which groups of organisms acquire distinct features and become separate species.

examples.text: Geographic isolation often leads to the <w>differentiation</w> of populations into new species.
The study examines the genetic <w>differentiation</w> between these two closely related bird groups.

senses.sense_definition: The process by which cooling magma separates into different types of rock.

examples.text: Magmatic <w>differentiation</w> explains the variety of igneous rocks found in the volcanic region.
The chemical composition of the lava changed due to the process of <w>differentiation</w> within the magma chamber.
